## Activity

During October 2019, Central Eye Clinic recorded 147 captures. This activity represents the total number of images submitted for review during the reporting month. The volume provides the basis for assessing image quality and the subsequent grading workload. No additional activity information was reported for the site.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during October 2019, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.4 per cent. These images could not be used for a reliable assessment and have been recorded separately from images suitable for grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 14 referable results from the activity reported by Central Eye Clinic. The median lag for grading was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading for the month. The results and turnaround information should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting.
